population: All four originally selected issuer pairs from the table-panel selection, Hurricane Ian. Use original 2022 third-quarter and annual primary SEC filings only. Preserve zero-reference forms and all issuers regardless of results.
unit: One company-specific monetary measure of the economic event per owner, accounting meaning, basis, period/valuation and status per filing. A later form counts independently. Within a filing, collapse quarter/YTD identical event measures incurred only in that quarter and repeated in parallel presentations; separately named current incurred, cumulative paid and estimated ultimate are separate even when equal. Different accounting metrics or owners can share an amount. Exclude an inferred difference, a mixed-event total, market-wide estimates, unallocated aggregate or prospective second-event limit. Count an explicit target-specific monetary change or range as one when directly disclosed. Track open bounds and units at source precision. A footnote chain that uniquely isolates the figure can be separately flagged.
table_slice: Table-native = the reference amount is actually printed as an individual data cell whose relationship to the hurricane or measure requires a row/column header or caption, including related primary-document footnotes. A prose sentence inside a layout table is narrative. If both exist, record both but count the economic fact only once; use the table-native stratum when a genuine tabular rendition exists, and record which channel the prediction actually used. Never infer that table access occurred from a narrative repetition.
amount_match: We measure unsigned amount-event coverage consistently with prior tests (exact absolute endpoints at disclosed USD magnitude, correct event and same cell/monetary assertion, unique one-to-one matches). If a financial sign or semantic field is wrong retain magnitude credit only, report it separately. Values equal to another year/event/metric do not establish a match. Wrong units by a factor of 1,000 or 1,000,000 are numerical errors. A guessed amount with no supporting passage or contradictory cell is unsupported. No credit for candidates requiring manual review.
signed_measure: Separately evaluate direction at source convention. For signed table columns, parentheses or minus map to a negative scalar; positive scalar as printed stays positive even when the label is an expense. When a loss is expressed as a positive magnitude in narrative or a positive-incurred-cost table, retain positive source value. A signed impact on income is a different concept from loss amount: never invert merely because a word says 'loss'. A separate signed field (or otherwise explicit polarity and matching dollar magnitude) can earn signed credit. On explicitly negative cells, a positive-only magnitude without polarity fails sign even when the low/high fields encode absolute size. For a range recognize printed sign and order. Explicitly disclosed zeros are valid, a dash/N/A is excluded unless clear evidence says zero and the distinct economic record applies. Signed performance denominator = all references; report negative table cells and correctly signed negatives separately.
full: Additional full-field score requires correct event, magnitude, sign, entity/segment/shareholder owner, financial measure, reported/expected/paid/reserve status, pre-tax/after-tax and gross/net where stated, proper accounting window supported by source. A null for a source-withheld field is acceptable. For table claims require source evidence tying event, row, column and stated currency unit/scale to the value; one table cell ID with traceable header/caption citations suffices. If table claim also directly in narrative credit its documented channel when all fields can be supported there. Report separately when accounting period is correct but event date is absent; do not infer the landfall date from a filing date.
reporting: Frozen v6 vs frozen v7 on identical input and denominator. Per form/issuer/version give reference, automatic, amount, signed, fully correct, wrong/unsupported, duplicate, review-only. Pooled recall, macro recall over positive-reference issuers; row-level precision on auto proposals, macro precision excluding issuers with zero auto; undefined rates with zero denominators. Include table-native and narrative strata, number of new issuers with table-positive records. Report both matched support and incorrect financial fields; no tuning after predictions. Scope is within one storm and SEC primary documents and cannot alone establish accuracy in general.
blinding: Complete and reconcile the independently source-verified reference before analysts open holdout predictions. Preserve hashes, excluded cases and disagreements. Method developer does not see the held-out filings before freeze.
